name: Noble
ability: You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.
wakes: First night only (or the first night after becoming the Noble mid-game).
interaction: Learns: 3 players, exactly 1 of which registers as evil.
drunk_or_poisoned: Drunk or poisoned: may be shown any 3 players (e.g. 0 or 2+ evil); misinformation offered centrally, storyteller picks.

rulings.text: The Noble is shown two good players and one evil player (marked KNOW); never 1 good + 2 evil or 3 evil.
Registration applies: a Spy may register good and a Recluse may register evil.
A Noble created mid-game (e.g. by the Pit-Hag) learns on their first night as the Noble.
The wiki does not say whether the Noble may be among the 3; assume other players only (uncertain).

test_scenarios.name: normal info
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Noble, Bob Chambermaid, Carol Po, Dave Barber, Eve Godfather, Fay Mayor.
test_scenarios.actions: First night: Noble wakes; storyteller picks Bob, Carol, Fay.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns Bob, Carol, Fay; exactly one (Carol) is evil.

test_scenarios.name: recluse registers evil
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Noble, Bob Chambermaid, Carol Barber, Dave Recluse, Eve Imp, Fay Poisoner.
test_scenarios.actions: First night: storyteller has Dave register as evil and picks Bob, Carol, Dave.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns Bob, Carol, Dave (Dave counted as the one evil).

test_scenarios.name: poisoned noble
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Noble, Bob Chef, Carol Imp, Dave Poisoner, Eve Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: First night: Poisoner poisons Alice before she wakes; misinformation options offered centrally, storyteller picks Bob, Carol, Dave.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns Bob, Carol, Dave (two evil).

test_scenarios.name: pit-hag makes a noble
test_scenarios.setup: Amy Klutz, Evin Clockmaker, Sarah Spy, Julian Po, Ben Pit-Hag.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 3: Pit-Hag turns Amy into the Noble; Sarah registers as good.
test_scenarios.expected: Amy wakes that night and learns Evin, Sarah, Julian (Julian the one evil).
